retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, high-contrast monochrome portrait characterized by heavy film grain and dramatic chiaroscuro lighting that obscures details in deep shadows.
triggerTerms: gritty black and white film grain portrait
excludeWhen: soft focus or smooth skin textures are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a face rendered in stark black and white with a heavy, sand-like grain texture. The lighting is directional, creating bright highlights on the bridge of the nose and forehead while leaving the periphery in deep, textured darkness.
coreVisualRelationships: Highlight-to-shadow ratio creates a dramatic vertical axis through the center of the face
Grain texture acts as a unifying layer over both subject and background
Extreme cropping focuses attention on the eyes and mouth
Dark values dominate the frame, pushing the subject forward through contrast
coreInvariants: Heavy monochromatic film grain texture across the entire image
High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting with deep blacks and blown-out whites
Extreme close-up framing of the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and scaled to fill nearly the entire frame, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright highlight on the bridge of the nose serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the central nose highlight outward to the eyes, then down to the lips, following the vertical light path.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the dark, grainy shadows around the edges of the face serve as the background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white and light grey for highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from 0 to 100 with limited mid-tones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white portrait with extreme close-up framing and chiaroscuro lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use bold, sans-serif typography with a distressed or weathered texture to match the image grain.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible and consistent across the frame?
Are the shadows deep black without losing the gritty texture?

avoid: Digital noise that looks like compression artifacts

postGenerationChecks: Check for blown-out highlights on the nose and forehead
Ensure the grain does not obscure the eyes entirely
Verify the absence of any color data
Confirm the crop is tight enough to be an extreme close-up
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a high-contrast B&W filter + heavy film grain overlay + extreme facial crop + directional key light.
